what: Our document-only serving cost per 1,000 waybills, corrected for the untrained-adapter drift in the timing run.
status: The RATE (tokens/second) is measured on this hardware and is weight-independent. The OUTPUT LENGTHS are the banked adapted arm's actual predictions, tokenized. The instance price is an external quote, not a measurement.
why_a_correction_was_needed: The timing run had to inject an untrained LoRA (the banked rehearsal adapter was not retained). An untrained adapter does not stop: it generated 197 tokens per document on average, against 93 for the answers the trained arm actually produced. Unadjusted wall-clock therefore overstates our cost -- the safe direction, and still wrong.

instance_rate.source: external 8-vCPU on-demand list price; deliberately cost-overstating against this 4-thread box

excludes: the one-time per-tenant adaptation cost, amortised over that tenant's volume and reported separately.
quality_note: This artifact contains no quality claim. Our adapted arm scores 0.8833 on these documents and the hosted tier scores 0.9708-1.0000; that comparison lives in Addendum I and is not improved by being cheaper.
